template: Open {{v1}} in the browser. If a login page appears, sign in with username 'admin' and password '{{v2}}' — type that exact text into the password field; the real password is filled in automatically as it is typed, so do not guess or look up the password. If Grafana asks you to change or skip updating the admin password after login, choose to skip it. Then find and open the provisioned dashboard named 'Service health' (use the dashboard search). When it is displayed, report the titles of its panels exactly as shown on the page.

provenance.instruction: Open http://127.0.0.1:3000/ in the browser. If a login page appears, sign in with username 'admin' and password '{{env:APP_PASSWORD}}' — type that exact text into the password field; the real password is filled in automatically as it is typed, so do not guess or look up the password. If Grafana asks you to change or skip updating the admin password after login, choose to skip it. Then find and open the provisioned dashboard named 'Service health' (use the dashboard search). When it is displayed, report the titles of its panels exactly as shown on the page.
